messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a kernel+quant bundle swap tonight, target cutover 23:00 UTC. Asking ops for handover and docs sign-off. :calendar:  

taylor: ETA for bake window and expected traffic slice?

maria: Bake window 22:30-23:00 UTC, smoke from 23:00-23:15 on a 5% traffic slice, then ramp to 50% over 30m if green.

lee: Any hard TTL for pins if rollback needed? prefer 1h sticky then auto-unpin.

juan: +1 on 1h sticky. Also add a hotpatch plan in release notes in case quant artifacts mismap.

maria: Agreed. Draft release note snippet uploaded to drive: https://drive.example/release/engine-quant-cutover.md :link:  

deploybot: preflight checks for engine-bundle:v3.4 starting...
deploybot: running smoke suite against staging nodes (staging-quant-*)
deploybot: preflight OK: binary checksums match, kernel ABI tag = kb-2026-03, quant-table v2.1 present

lee: @deploybot can you print the target hosts and the rollout command?

deploybot: targets: region-eu-rtpool[0..23], region-us-rtpool[0..47]
deploybot: rollout command: ```/deploy engine-bundle:v3.4 --mode rolling --slice 0.05 --stagger 60s --pin-ttl 3600```

taylor: Add a safety fallback: if error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, automatic rollback to engine-bundle:v3.3.1 and unpin.

maria: Ack. Setting autosafety thresholds in deploy config now.

sre-bot: alert policy attached: /policies/engine-cutover-5751230000 — rollback_on_sla_breach=true, notify=#eng-oncall,#eng-runtime

juan: We'll run a small prefix-cache warmup job 22:45 UTC to warm KV caches — reduces noisy cold-starts during 5% slice.

lee: One more ask: ensure quant kernels compiled with AVX fallback for older nodes. ops, can you confirm compiler flags?

juan: Compiler flags: -march=skylake -mavx2 -DQUANT_TABLE=v2 --fallback=avx. Pushing build artifact with both AVX and scalar variants.

maria: Release notes checklist: 1) rollback steps verified, 2) pin TTL = 3600s, 3) smoke queries & eval prompt set attached, 4) ops handover + oncall tagged. All done.

taylor: I'll be watching telemetry and ready to escalate. :eyes:  

deploybot: starting rollout at 5751230600 (23:00 UTC) in 5% slice. Logs at https://deploys.example/5751230000

maria: Thanks team — post-deploy thread will go to #eng-runtime and I'll update the release doc with final notes.

lee: If anything flaps, call for rollback immediately — no half-measures.

juan: Copy. standby on hotpatch build if we need to swap quant tables fast.

sre-bot: deployment event recorded. Incident channel bridged to #incidents if rollback triggers.
